offering_description.value: HireQuest supplies temporary workers and recruits permanent hires for employers. It delivers these services primarily through franchised staffing and executive search offices and supports its franchisees with payroll, billing, and workers’ compensation administration.

primary_services.value: temporary staffing; temp-to-hire staffing; direct-hire recruiting; executive search; franchise back-office administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Construction contractors, manufacturers, warehouse and logistics operators, and employers hiring office staff, professionals, and executives

end_markets.value: construction; manufacturing; warehousing and logistics; commercial office staffing; executive and professional recruitment

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: Franchisees pay for brand rights and operating support; service fees: Employers pay for temporary labor and permanent placements through the office network

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Recruits workers for employer assignments and placements and handles payroll and billing for franchisees

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with international reach through executive search franchises

specialization.value: related lines: Day labor, skilled trades and commercial staffing, direct-hire recruiting, and executive search

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Local staffing franchise offices and franchised executive search firms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Temporary staffing is subject to wage and hour rules, OSHA requirements, and state workers’ compensation laws

notes: The current country-by-country footprint of the executive search network is uncertain.
